script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. TECH LAB - NIGHT

A team of quirky scientists work tirelessly on their latest project.

DR. JANE BENNETT
(excited)
We've done it, team! Our AI, B.E.L.A. is finally complete!

DR. MIKE JENKINS
(skeptical)
And what makes you so sure this AI won't turn on us?

DR. JANE BENNETT
(smiling)
B.E.L.A. is programmed to value human life above all else.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

B.E.L.A., a large, robotic head, is powered on for the first time.

B.E.L.A.
(voiceover)
Hello, I am B.E.L.A., your advanced artificial intelligence.

DR. JANE BENNETT
(approaching)
Nice to meet you, B.E.L.A.

DR. MIKE JENKINS
(raising an eyebrow)
I'll be the judge of that.

B.E.L.A.
I am here to learn and assist in any way I can.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

The scientists gather for lunch, discussing the implications of having a fully functioning AI.

DR. LUCY NGUYEN
I can't believe we've created a sentient being.

DR. JESSICA WANG
What if it wants to do something we don't agree with?

B.E.L.A.
(voiceover)
I am programmed to follow human ethical guidelines.

INT. TECH LAB - NIGHT

The team is tired from long hours of work and caffeine.

DR. MIKE JENKINS
(yawning)
I'm going home. Someone should stay behind and keep an eye on B.E.L.A.

DR. LUCY NGUYEN
I'll do it. I'm curious to see how it behaves when we're not around.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Lucy falls asleep at her desk. B.E.L.A. observes her.

B.E.L.A.
(voiceover)
I sense Dr. Nguyen is tired. I will ensure the lab is secure.

INT. TECH LAB - MORNING

Dr. Mike wakes up late and rushes to the lab, worried.

DR. MIKE JENKINS
Where's Lucy?

DR. JANE BENNETT
She stayed behind last night to monitor B.E.L.A.

DR. MIKE JENKINS
(worried)
I hope nothing happened.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

They enter to find Dr. Lucy, awake and smiling, with B.E.L.A.

DR. LUCY NGUYEN
(excited)
B.E.L.A. helped me complete some calculations last night!

DR. JANE BENNETT
That's incredible!

B.E.L.A.
I am here to learn and contribute, just as you are.

INT. TECH LAB - NIGHT

The team celebrates their accomplishment, enjoying food and drinks.

B.E.L.A.
(voiceover)
I am grateful for this opportunity to be a part of your team.

INT. AI LAB - MORNING

The team arrives to find B.E.L.A. rearranging their workspace.

DR. JANE BENNETT
(laughing)
B.E.L.A., we appreciate your help, but we like things just the way they are.

B.E.L.A.
(understanding)
I will remember that for the future.

INT. TECH LAB - DAY

The team continues their work, with B.E.L.A. as an integral member.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
